crossRefs.note: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking…
Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
translations.bsb: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
translations.kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
translations.asv: The Samaritan woman therefore saith unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, who am a Samaritan woman? (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
